messages:
jessica: FYI customer 'LinguaAI' reporting embeddings dashboard shows 'units' that look like vectors + tokens combined, causing a billing spike. Customer ID: cus_48a2. Time range: 2026-03-12 00:00-03:00 UTC. They attached repro steps.

samir: Can you paste the customer ID and the sample API call? :eyes: 

jessica: cus_48a2. Sample API call they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"text-embed-3-small\",\"input\":[\"foo\",\"bar\"]}'
```
They reported dashboard shows ~4,800 "units" for ~1k vectors; tokens show ~30k. Tooltip just says 'units' which is ambiguous.

maria: Sounds like unit_type tagging was lost somewhere in the pipeline. If both 'vector' and 'token' counts get funneled into a single metric without unit_type grouping you get conflation. I'll look at the metrics pipeline.

jessica: Ran a quick query on metrics-prod (snippet):
```sql
SELECT event_time, unit_type, SUM(count) as c
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE customer_id='cus_48a2' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-12 03:00'
GROUP BY event_time, unit_type
ORDER BY event_time
LIMIT 20;
```
Result: same event_time appears twice — one row with unit_type=NULL and one with unit_type='vector' — counts add up when dashboard aggregates.

dev-bot: [ingest-stream] WARNING shard-4 duplicate-event-detected id=evt_9f3a :repeat: 

maria: Found root cause — dedupe key for the stream was non-deterministic when unit_type was null, so some events re-emitted without unit_type. Aggregator then coalesced NULL into default 'embed_units' metric. Fix: enforce unit_type fallback earlier and group-by unit_type in aggregation.

alex: Is this display-only or does it hit billing? Finance needs clarity.

jessica: Finance confirmed invoices pull from the same aggregated table, so billing was affected. Customer sees a charge spike; they're requesting credit.

maria: Building hotfix: (1) change aggregator to group by unit_type, (2) patch ingestion to set unit_type='token'|'vector' deterministically, (3) backfill script to recalc aggregates for the affected window. Deploying to staging now.

samir: How can we repro locally?

jessica: Repro steps:
```bash
# 1) send embeddings without unit_type
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{\"model\":\"text-embed-3-small\",\"input\":[\"a\"]}'
# 2) run ingest simulator
python tools/sim_ingest.py --customer cus_48a2 --events 1000 --omit-unit-type
# 3) query metrics table as above and observe duplicate event_time rows
```

alex: Please freeze billing for cus_48a2 and create a credit ticket. CS to notify LinguaAI. :thumbsup: 

dev-bot: [deploy] metrics-aggregator v1.3.7 -> prod SUCCESS at 1851234689

jessica: Confirmed with customer: dashboard numbers normalized after the patch; finance issued a provisional credit and customer acknowledged. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
